Maria (Marketing): Heads-up: aiming for Friday press window — need final changelog, docs link, benchmark blurb, and confirmed rollout times by EOD Thursday. Can eng confirm? @Dave
Dave (Engineering): We can do it. Canary Fri 17:00 UTC, full rollout 20:00 UTC. PR for changelog landed: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/456
Maria (Marketing): Perfect. Can we paste the final changelog snippet here so we can prep release notes? Also need a stable docs URL for copy.
Liz (Docs): Docs are staged at https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/feature-adaptive-routing. I'll push to prod as soon as we flip the deploy. ETA 20:05 UTC.
Sam (Eng-ML): Benchmark blurb: 'Adaptive routing reduces average per-token compute by ~35% on mixed short/long workloads; 1.8x throughput on 2k-sequence tails vs baseline.' Want a 1-line phrasing or full paragraph?
Maria (Marketing): 1-line for the press, paragraph for blog. If you paste both we'll iterate.
Dave (Engineering): Changelog snippet (copied from PR):
```
- Feature: Adaptive routing for model fallbacks
- Perf: ~1.8x throughput on 2k seqs (mixed load)
- Fix: KV-cache rebuild race on high-concurrency
```
We'll tag the PR with release v1.4.0
Maria (Marketing): :thumbsup: Can you confirm we should hold the embargo until 20:00 UTC? Marketing will schedule posts for 20:05 UTC.
Dave (Engineering): Yes hold until full rollout. Canary signals only internal until 20:00. If canary is healthy we flip at 20:00.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> 2026-11-05T17:00:00Z, promote -> 2026-11-05T20:00:00Z. Triggered by: dave
Oliver (Growth): Webinar for deeper dive — can we get the paragraph + 2 technical bullets by Friday noon PT? I'll wire up registration page: https://events.redwood.ai/rr-webinar
Sam (Eng-ML): Paragraph (for blog): 'Adaptive routing intelligently selects model variants at request time, balancing latency and cost. On our benchmark suite, this approach reduced average per-token compute by 35% while preserving quality across chat and long-context tasks.' Bullets:
- '35% avg per-token compute reduction (mixed workloads)'
- '1.8x throughput improvement on 2k sequences'
- 'Seamless fallback to smaller variants under load'
Maria (Marketing): Love it. We'll craft the press headline and social. Copy deadline for marketing: Fri 09:00 PT. @Liz will you confirm prod docs URL once deployed?
Liz (Docs): I'll post the prod link in this thread when live.
Dave (Engineering): Also important: risk/fallback note for PR: if latency spike post-promote, we'll rollback to previous routing config (runbook: `ops rollback routing v1.3`). Oncall: @Sam
Maria (Marketing): Noted — we'll include a note for press ops. Thanks everyone. I'll assemble final release packet and share draft by 08:30 PT.
Oliver (Growth): :party-parrot: I'll schedule social posts for 20:05 UTC and draft the webinar invite.
